data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 1/6): Specify usage.json write semantics. dispatch.py calls litellm.completion at 6+ sites + dispatch_two_call_review runs reviewers in parallel. AC must specify: (a) append-per-reviewer-dispatch (NOT overwrite), each entry tagged by agent_id + cycle + call_index; (b) under fcntl.LOCK_EX, read-modify-write atomic; (c) lock-file path = ${ARTIFACTS_DIR}/.review-cycle-usage.lock co-located with usage.json. Add RED test: 4 concurrent dispatch_review calls → 4 entries in usage.json (not 1).
